	definition:
		boss: Staff = Staff.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = bossid),
		staffList: Set(Staff) = Staff.allInstance()->select(o|o.Id = id),
		existStaff: Boolean = if staffList.isEmpty() = false 
		then true 
		else false 
		endif 
	precondition:
		boss.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		Staff.allInstance()->isUnique(o: Staff|o.Id)
	postcondition:
		existStaff = true and
		result = true or
		existStaff = false and
		(let newStaff: Staff in
		newStaff.oclIsNew() and
		Staff.allInstance()->includes(newStaff) and
		newStaff.Id = id and
		newStaff.Name = name and
		newStaff.Password = pswd and
		newStaff.Phone = phone and
		newStaff.Role = role and
		newStaff.Boss = boss and
		result = true)
}
